# Bali Phone Repair

> Bali Phone Repair is a premier device repair service in Bali specializing in iPhone, Samsung Galaxy, Android phones, MacBook, iPad, and Windows laptop repairs. We operate certified physical walk-in workshops in Canggu and Denpasar, and provide island-wide on-site villa and hotel repair service.

Official Website: https://baliphonerepair.com/

- Warranty: 30 to 60-day replacement parts and labor warranty
- Payment Accepted: Cash (IDR, USD, EUR, AUD), Visa/Mastercard, Wise, Bank Transfer, GoPay, OVO, Dana

## Physical Walk-in Workshop Locations in Bali

Bali Phone Repair operates three dedicated physical service locations across South Bali (all open daily 09:00–21:00):

1. **iSmart Canggu (Canggu & Berawa Hub)**
   - Address: Jl. Raya Canggu, Kerobokan, Badung, Bali 80361
   - Area Served: Canggu, Berawa, Pererenan, Batu Bolong, Echo Beach, Kerobokan, Seminyak
   - Hours: Monday–Sunday 09:00–21:00 (Open Every Day, 9 AM – 9 PM)
   - Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?q=iSmart+Canggu+Bali
   - Highlights: Fast walk-ins for tourists, digital nomads, and expats; same-day screen & battery swaps; rapid mobile villa technician dispatch.

2. **Bale Bali (Central Workshop & Diagnostic Lab)**
   - Address: Jl. Pulau Misol No. 106, Dauh Puri Kauh, Denpasar, Bali 80113
   - Area Served: Denpasar, Sanur, Kuta, Jimbaran, Uluwatu, Ubud
   - Hours: Monday–Sunday 09:00–21:00 (Open Every Day, 9 AM – 9 PM)
   - Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?q=Bali+Phone+Repair+Jl+Pulau+Misol+106+Denpasar
   - Highlights: High-capacity workshop with ultrasonic cleaning baths, microscopes, logic board micro-soldering, and extensive OEM spare parts inventory.

3. **iSmart Teuku Umar (Tech Corridor Branch)**
   - Address: Jl. Teuku Umar No. 241, Dauh Puri Kauh, Denpasar Barat, Bali 80113
   - Area Served: Teuku Umar tech strip, Denpasar, Renon, Kuta
   - Hours: Monday–Sunday 09:00–21:00 (Open Every Day, 9 AM – 9 PM)
   - Google Maps: https://maps.google.com/?q=iSmart+Teuku+Umar+Denpasar
   - Highlights: Specialized equipment for back glass laser separation, component-level micro-soldering, and iPad display laminating.

## Core Services & Capabilities

- **iPhone Repair Bali**: Same-day screen replacement (OLED/LCD), genuine battery replacement, charging port repair, camera lens & glass repair, speaker/mic replacement, water damage treatment.
- **Samsung & Android Phone Repair**: AMOLED display replacement for Samsung Galaxy S and Z series, Xiaomi, Oppo, Google Pixel, Vivo, Asus, OnePlus.
- **MacBook & Laptop Repair**: MacBook Pro & Air M1/M2/M3/Intel repair, screen replacement, logic board diagnosis & repair, battery replacement, thermal paste renewal, keyboard & trackpad replacement.
- **iPad & Tablet Repair**: Glass digitizer & LCD replacement, battery swap, charging port and corrosion cleaning.
- **Emergency Saltwater & Liquid Damage Recovery**: Chemical immersion, ultrasonic bath cleaning, board micro-soldering, and NVMe SSD / internal NAND data recovery for devices exposed to ocean water or pools.
- **Mobile On-Site Villa / Hotel Repair**: Dedicated motorcycle technicians dispatch directly to villas, hotels, cafes, and coworking spaces across Bali with complete diagnostic toolsets. Repairs completed in 30–60 minutes right in front of the customer.
